requirement_understanding: The FG (Finished Goods) Master module manages finished textile/manufacturing products. Users can create, view, search, edit, and delete FG master records. Each record contains attributes such as Item Code, Item Name, Width, Length, Reed, Pick, GSM, Shrinkage, Distance, Optional fields, and Minutes Per Unit. Comprehensive test coverage requires full CRUD operations, boundary and field validation with isolated single-field variations, database state consistency, and user workflow validations.
requirement_gaps: Unclear field length constraints for FG Item Code and FG Item Name.
Unspecified numerical range limits and precision rules for GSM, Width, Length, Shrinkage, Reed, Pick, and Minutes Per Unit.
Soft delete vs hard delete behavior not specified for deleted FG items.
Missing audit log requirement for tracking edits or deletions on FG master records.
business_rules: FG Item Code must be unique across the enterprise system.
FG Item Code and FG Item Name are mandatory required fields.
Width, Length, GSM, Shrinkage, Distance, and Minutes Per Unit must be positive numeric values.
A confirmation modal must be triggered before permanent deletion of an FG Master record.
assumptions: User is authenticated and has administrative permissions to create, edit, and delete FG master records.
Target environment has pre-populated master tables for dropdown options.
Network requests return standard JSON REST API responses with proper HTTP status codes.
risks: Accidental deletion of active Finished Goods items linked to active Sales Orders or Production Orders.
Data corruption due to unvalidated numeric boundaries in manufacturing calculations.
Lack of duplicate code validation on concurrent creation requests leading to database primary key collisions.

test_strategy.objectives: Validate full end-to-end functionality of FG Master workflow including creation, reading, updating, deletion, input boundary edge cases, and search functionality with zero regression on core ERP flows.
test_strategy.scope_in: FG Master grid page, Add/Edit modal dialogs, Search/Filter functionality, Confirmation dialogs, Single-field boundary validations, and basic UI responsiveness.
test_strategy.scope_out: Authentication flow, global role-based access control management, external SAP/ERP synchronization background jobs.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute database seed reset script to clean up generated test FG records and restore baseline state.

from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_fg_master_crud_flow(page: Page):
    # Navigate directly to module page (assumes session pre-authenticated)
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("FG Master")')
    
    # Add New FG Item
    page.click('button:has-text("Add New")')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Enter FG item code"]', 'FG-AUTO-01')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Enter FG item name"]', 'Automated FG Item')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Width"]', '50')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Length"]', '100')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="GSM"]', '150')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Minutes per unit"]', '10')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')
    
    # Search Created Item
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Search by FG Item Code, FG Item Name"]', 'FG-AUTO-01')
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('FG-AUTO-01')

# FG Master Module Quality Assurance Documentation

## Module Overview
The Finished Goods (FG) Master module allows administrative users to configure and manage product specifications used across manufacturing and enterprise operations.

## Tested Workflows
1. **Create Record**: Access form via 'Add New', complete parameters, click Save.
2. **View Record**: Click details view icon to review item attributes.
3. **Edit Record**: Modify name, dimensions, or time units and save changes.
4. **Delete Record**: Remove FG items via confirmation dialog ('Yes, Delete').
5. **Search/Filter**: Search items dynamically using Item Code or Name.

## Single-Field Isolation Validation
Boundary and negative tests ensure single field failures are verified independently without cross-contaminating validation feedback.
